# Tooltip & Popover

## Tooltip

Dark tooltip; arrow None, Top, Bottom, Left, Right.

Variants: 10

| Property | Type / options |
|---|---|
| Text | text |
| Supporting text | False · True |
| Arrow | None · Top · Bottom · Left · Right |

**Do**

- Use for short hints on icon buttons and truncated text.
- Keep it to one sentence.
- Point the arrow at the trigger.

**Forbidden**

- Never put links or actions in a tooltip.
- Never explain a disabled button only with a tooltip.
- Never repeat the visible label.
